verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published account of how Latham uses AI in client service. It names no AI tools, sets out no AI-use policy, and describes no AI-practice product. The LathamDrive document generator and the OpenLaw-based Automated Convertible Note are document-automation tools, not documented AI use, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the firm publishes how it uses AI in client service — named tools, policies, or AI-practice products of its own — beyond a marketing mention
